# Dental Med Austria

> premium-quality dental clinic in Tirana, Albania (est. 2009, ISO 9001). Implants, crowns, veneers, All-on-4/6, orthodontics and full-mouth rehabilitation for international patients from Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Italy and the UK. Premium implant systems (Swiss-made Straumann, ETK, Alpha-Bio, Biodem) and Ivoclar IPS e.max ceramics, 5-year treatment guarantee, multilingual coordinators, full dental-tourism support (airport pickup, partner hotels).

Important: Albania is not in the EU; German, Austrian and Swiss statutory health insurance does not reimburse planned treatment in Albania. The clinic issues an itemized written treatment plan patients can use for private insurance or tax purposes. Exact prices come from a free written treatment plan (send a panoramic X-ray and photos).

- [Care & process](https://www.dentalmedaustria.al/en/care): how a treatment trip works, step by step
- [Technology](https://www.dentalmedaustria.al/en/technology): CBCT, 3D-guided surgery, in-house lab
- [Team](https://www.dentalmedaustria.al/en/team): dentists and credentials (founder: Dr. Mentor Zeqja, orthodontist)
- [Smile gallery](https://www.dentalmedaustria.al/en/smiles): real before/after patient results
- [Safety & hygiene](https://www.dentalmedaustria.al/en/safety): sterilisation protocols and material traceability
- [Contact](https://www.dentalmedaustria.al/en/contact): free written treatment plan, address, hours
